components.text:
Pick a scenario with the buttons above, or edit the fields directly. The four the agent behaves differently on — every one against the same 4200 USD purchase order:

| Scenario | Invoice amount | Currency | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clean match (default) | 4200 | USD | Quarterly office supplies delivery per PO, no changes. |
| Documented overage, 4.5% over | 4389 | USD | Includes pre-approved rush freight surcharge agreed with procurement on 12 Jan. |
| Foreign currency, converts and matches | 3860 | EUR | Quarterly office supplies delivery per PO, billed in euros. |
| Vague justification, 7% over (deny this one) | 4494 | USD | Additional items supplied. |

For the first three, approve the release when the **Review release request** form appears below the diagram. For the last one, the notes are just specific enough that the agent will still ask to release it - deny it instead, and watch it read the denial and notify the vendor of a dispute. Every scenario then reaches a second, independent **Final compliance sign-off** once the agent is done.

components.label: Invoice notes
components.description: Free text - the agent reads this to judge whether any overage above the PO amount is documented.
components.defaultValue: Quarterly office supplies delivery per PO, no changes.
